## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem or motivation
What problem does this solve, or what use case does it support?
_Example: "When exporting multiple features I need to include X field because..."_

## Proposed solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative approaches you have thought of.

## Additional context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or examples that illustrate the feature.
